fem.text: Vaylesh, the cruel high priestess of the Order of the Ebon Hand, captures Tymolin and lures the Farrelites to the Ebon Hand camp, where Farrel stabs Tymolin to death when she refuses him.
Sensing his sister's death, Tev transforms into the dragon-like Tevesh Szat and incinerates the Ebon Hand encampment, killing Vaylesh along with Sianna, Farrel and their forces.
